title: Deployed Cabal LST Move package is a post-audit build in which Code4rena H-01 is fixed
closed_reasons: Live package 0x53c3f5d8e11844ba3747ebaec1b2d25051574ffbeedc69d72068395991e3ea28 on Initia mainnet (interwoven-1) is a different, post-audit 16-module build; the audited address 0xe472ba1c... has 0 modules on mainnet.

The audited function process_lp_unstake is ABSENT from the live cabal module; its successor process_lp_undelegate adds the burned shares back into the supply denominator (s_eff = supply_after_burn + unstake_amount).

Live process_lp_stake, get_estimate_unstake_amount and get_cabal_stake_token_price_rel_to_underlying add unstaked_pending_amounts to the denominator -- exactly the audit's recommended H-01 mitigation.
Live integer oracle: get_estimate_unstake_amount(1,1000000) = 1737428 = real/(supply+pending) (deployed/fixed), NOT 1737469 = real/supply (audited/buggy).
key_facts: Audited: code4n4/2025-04-cabal @ 5b5f92ab4f95e5f9f405bbfa252860472d164705; H-01 in sources/cabal.move process_lp_unstake L1043-L1085 (no mitigation review in the report).
Live package: 0x53c3f5d8e11844ba3747ebaec1b2d25051574ffbeedc69d72068395991e3ea28 (Initia interwoven-1), 16 modules, all upgrade_policy=COMPATIBLE.
cabal module sha256 36379fa2e72e6ff81ab3487e9552be9c59b995254bca1002cc18c088387c90a5 (18207 bytes), disassembled with aptos-cli 9.6.0 from the REST raw_bytes.
Audited cabal.move declares ~53 public/entry fns (incl. test helpers), live cabal module ABI exposes 67; process_lp_unstake renamed to process_lp_undelegate.
Live state height 23352892: supply(cabal_token[1])=2726911250625, unstaked_pending_amounts[1]=63778039 (63.778 LP, nonzero), get_real_total_stakes(LP)=4737924767617.
emergency::paused=false; batch_undelegate_pending_lps is permissionless (3-day rate limit), so no privileged gate hides a latent H-01.
The audited H-01 over-claim is a transfer from other holders bounded by the pending amount (63.78 LP ~ $15 today), not a full-pool drain.
caveats: Read-only: no transaction signed/sent, so the verdict rests on bytecode disassembly + a permissionless view-function oracle, not a signed round-trip.
The live package is upgradeable (COMPATIBLE); ci/run.sh re-checks module sha256 and flags any upgrade.
This 16-module revision has no published audit covering it; only the H-01 question was assessed, not the newer unstaked_release_amount / whale-voting mechanisms.
cabal-1 vaults (~$128k) and strat-1 xSLP (~$503k) are separate products, not the audited LST; not assessed.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 from Cabal LST today: the live Initia Move package is a post-audit rewrite (process_lp_unstake gone; process_lp_undelegate and all price/stake paths add unstaked_pending_amounts back into the denominator), confirmed by bytecode disassembly and a live view oracle returning the fixed formula (1737428) rather than the audited buggy one (1737469).
